messages.subject: Tomorrow: Tidyverse talk + work session
parts:
Hi all,

I will give a talk at our weekly meeting tomorrow on the "tidyverse" (formerly "Hadleyverse"), which is about 20 R packages that work together to make most of what you do in R easier, faster, and less bug-prone. If you're new to R, come: the tidyverse syntax is less obtuse than base R and the consistency is refreshing. If you already use a few tidyverse packages like ggplot2 or dplyr, come: learn about additional tools that fit in your existing pipelines to make your work easier. And if you program with lists and don't know purrr yet, come: I just learned it and am quite excited about it -- convenient map-reduce functions, type-stable try and unlist, list-columns in data frames, and more. I'll walk through what each of these packages does, explain why you might want to use it, and demo its functionality and advantages over the base R alternatives. I will also demo the new R Notebooks, which is a nice way to build a dynamic document chunk by chunk.

We will start at 1:10pm, the talk will probably go to about 2:00, and we will have the usual work session after. In person in Wickson 2124, or if you can't make it, stream live and chat in your questions here. You can download the talk source materials here, sometime before 1pm tomorrow :).

See you tomorrow,

Michael
